_comment: Lead candidate cards. `party` is a template code from data/parties.json and supplies the card colour, so nothing here repeats a hex value. `role` is the line under the name; `bio` the short paragraph. Order is the order they appear. Two parties are standing a duo, both named on one card.

items.name: Stefan Evers
items.bio: Finance senator in the Wegner senate and previously the Berlin CDU's general secretary, leading the list for a party that has fallen about eight points since winning in 2023.

items.name: Elif Eralp
items.bio: Lead candidate for the party that has gained most since 2023, roughly doubling its share and leading or tying the lead in most polls published since July.

items.name: Kristin Brinker
items.bio: Berlin AfD state chair and parliamentary group leader, standing again after the party's 9.1% in 2023.

items.name: Werner Graf & Bettina Jarasch
items.bio: A duo: Graf co-chairs the parliamentary group, Jarasch was the Greens' lead candidate in 2021 and 2023 and a former senator for the environment and mobility.

items.name: Steffen Krach
items.bio: Lead candidate for the SPD, defending the junior half of the governing coalition with the party polling at its lowest level in Berlin since reunification.

items.name: Alexander King & Michael Lüders
items.bio: A duo leading the Sahra Wagenknecht Alliance's first Berlin campaign, with the party polling either side of the 5% threshold.
